CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 3, 2025

The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting - February 3,
  2025 (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting - February 3, 2025 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:59 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Fisher, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  None

  Commissioner Dorado arrived at 7:04 P.M.

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Principal Planner; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Karabeth
  Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – SEPTEMBER 16, 2024 (7:00 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the September 16, 2024, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the September 16, 2024, Regular
  Meeting of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – SEPTEMBER 19, 2022 (7:00 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the September 19, 2022, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the September 19, 2022, Regular
  Meeting of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  MINUTES – AUGUST 15, 2022 (7:00 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the August 15, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the August 15, 2022, Regular Meeting of

  1
   the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1, 2, and 3.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Mojarro.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Fisher,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Dorado

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-24-04 (7:03 P.M.)
  • 1227 West Valley Boulevard, Unit 117
  • Applicant: Claudia Mbah
  • Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-04 is a request to permit a
  vocational nursing school located within an existing commercial
  tenant space at 1227 West Valley Boulevard, Unit 117 in the CMU
  (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-01 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-04 permitting a vocational
  nursing school subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-04 permitting a vocational
  nursing school to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301,
  Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which
  exempts from CEQA review projects that are existing facilities.
  • Senior Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  • Claudia Mbah, the Applicant, provided the Applicant presentation
  and was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham,
  Fisher, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  2
 G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  There were no Comments or Conference/Meeting Reports from the Planning

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  There were no comments from staff.

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:11 P.M. to Monday,
  March 3, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.
